topic: New build inspections: the three walks that are not yours
hook: New builds get inspected three times. None of them for you.

scores.worst_problem: The payoff is scoped only to the pre-drywall walk while the deck's sharpest, most novel beat is the month-eleven warranty deadline, so the artefact under-delivers on half the promise the carousel built.
scores.fix: Widen the DM payoff to cover both windows explicitly — e.g. 'the two-page checklist I hand buyers: what to photograph at pre-drywall and what to flag at month eleven'.

topic: What surprises Texas transplants (SA, Austin, DFW)
hook: Nobody warns transplants about the 11 weeks.

scores.worst_problem: The close splits the ask — an answerable three-way question is immediately undercut by 'Save this for later,' giving the reader two competing actions and letting the easier one win.
scores.fix: Cut 'Save this for later' and make the question carry the whole slide, e.g. 'Hill country afternoon, Gulf coast weekend, or DFW lake day? One word in the comments.'

topic: Year one four houses to year four pipeline
hook: Year one I sold four houses. Year four explains why.

scores.worst_problem: The hook withholds detail but not shape — "year four explains why" telegraphs a patience-compounds arc that a reader can guess before swiping, so the deck confirms rather than reveals.
scores.fix: Rewrite slide 1 so the gap is a contradiction rather than a timeline, e.g. lead with the specific thing the slow year cost you or the deal you refused, so the reader cannot pre-write the lesson.
